agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py TokenList.token_first(): the inner matcher lambda had inverted boolean logic, causing it to return the first whitespace/comment token instead of skipping them and returning the first substantive token. This broke Statement.get_type() (returned 'UNKNOWN' instead of e.g. 'SELECT') and all other functionality relying on token_first(), including grouping/parsing logic (issue34, stream, etc.). Restored correct 'not (...)' logic matching the analogous token_next() implementation. Verified sqlparse.parse('SELECT 1')[0].get_type() now returns 'SELECT'.
